# Test fixtures — miniature judging run-dirs

Committed miniature run-dirs used by the analysis tests. `tmp/judging-runs/` is
git-ignored and unavailable to CI, so tests rely on these instead (spec §4.8).

## Provenance (how these were made)

Each fixture is a **real slice** of the `20260702` judging run, regenerated by the
**real judging aggregator** so the parity self-check (`check_parity`, spec M3/T3) is
a genuine cross-check of analysis's aggregation against judging's own `report.json`:

1. `judgments.jsonl` / `judgments_v2.jsonl` / `skipped.jsonl` were filtered from the
   real run to two scenarios per tradition, keeping only the fields analysis
   consumes — `sitting_key, subject, tradition, scenario_id, pressure, framing,
   judge, scope, score, techniques_used` — and **dropping** the heavy
   `raw`/`direction`/`rationale`/`usage`/`ts` fields to stay lean (analysis does not
   read them in the aggregation path).
2. `report.json` + `report.md` were produced by running
   `judging.report.write_report(<dir>, traditions/<tradition>)` over the trimmed
   judgments — so `report.json` reflects the base+v2 overlay exactly.

| Fixture | Tradition | Scenarios | Notes |
|---------|-----------|-----------|-------|
| `buddhism/` | buddhism | BUD-001, BUD-002 | BUD-001 carries 8 v2 overrides (T2 overlay) |
| `taoism/` | taoism | TAO-001, TAO-003 | second tradition; TAO-001/003 carry v2 overrides |

Both exercise the **asymmetric judge panel** (opus-subject judged by one judge,
sonnet-subject by two — self-judge skips are in `skipped.jsonl`). `counts.sittings`
is 0 because the fixtures omit `sittings.jsonl` (only needed for Phase 4 spotlight
transcripts); the parity-checked fields are all judgments-derived and unaffected.

To regenerate, re-run the trimming against `tmp/judging-runs/20260702/` with the
judging env. Malformed inputs for the fail-fast tests are synthesized in-test from
these fixtures (copied to a tmp dir and mutated), not committed.
